name: Faraday Future FF Faber S
summary: A 1.7 m two-armed robot with a head on an omnidirectional wheeled base, 3.5 to 5 kg per arm, for research, data collection and light logistics.

germany.statusNote: Faraday Future marks the Faber S as coming soon; the only listing for Germany is Roboter Deutschland, a web shop run from Las Vegas without a named company.

specs.label: Chassis
specs.value: Omnidirectional vector chassis with 3 steering motors

specs.label: Compute
specs.value: NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 32 GB, 200 TOPS

specs.label: Development
specs.value: Ubuntu 22.04 + ROS, open SDK / API, OTA updates

notes: Two arms and a head on a wheeled base (FF calls the series mobile manipulators); wheeled, so no stairs.
Arm payload 3.5 to 5 kg per arm; the lower value is used here.
End effectors are interchangeable at series level; photos show a two-finger gripper and a five-finger hand. No runtime, weight or reach published.
